Note: You can address the letter as ‘Dear Parents, Carers and
Students,

LECTURE: First Aid for Burns.
1. Types of burns
* thickness of burns / 1st, 2"4, 3"4 degree

* caused by petrol, chemicals, electrici
Second

, steam, hot water
Third (Full Thickness)

Depth (how Epithelium Epithelium and top aspects of _| Epithelium and dermis
deep the burn is) the dermis
How the wound No blisters; dry pink Moist, oozing blisters; Moist, Leathery, dry, no elasticity; charred
looks white, pink, to red appearance
Causes Sunbum, scald, flash Scalds, flash bums, chemicals | Contact with flame, hot surface, hot
flame liquids, chemical, electric
Level of Pain Painful, tender, and sore | Very painful Very little pain, or no pain
(sensation)
Healing Time Two to five days; peeling | Superficial: five to 21 days Small areas may take months to heal,
Deep: 21-35 days large areas need grafting.
Scarring No scarring; may have —_| Minimal to no scarring; may Scarring present
discoloration have discoloration

2. First Aid for major burns
* Move person away from danger (fire / electricity / chemical)

* Remove clothing and jewellery if possible (possible swelling) /
leave if stuck to skin

* Call emergency number / stay with patient

_ + Wash burn with lukewarm water / tap water OK/ keep flushing
il emerg services arrive

hydrate patient — water / no alcohol!
rtant! :

put butter on burn — old wive’s tale
